annotations.title: Speech to text, transcribe audio: Whisper transcription of an audio file

description: Transcribe speech from an audio file at a public URL using Whisper large-v3-turbo. Returns the transcript text, detected language, duration and word count. Accepts common formats such as MP3, WAV, M4A and OGG up to 5 MB. Use for voice notes, podcast clips, meeting snippets and voice messages. Example: url=https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:FilePath/En-us-hello.ogg. Price $0.02/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of an audio file (max 5 MB)
